_nota: Inglés de `countermeasures.json` (`core/i18n.py`): castellano exacto → inglés, valor entero por valor entero. El fichero castellano no se toca; las claves, los ids y las frases literales de una fuente no se traducen. Lo aplica `i18n.localized` al servir.

strings.Completar la sesión de ejercicio aeróbic: Consider completing the protocol's aerobic and resistive exercise session.
strings.Desacondicionamiento cardiovascular: der: Cardiovascular deconditioning: drift in resting heart rate or in heart rate variability.
strings.La Agencia Espacial Canadiense dice: «Ov: The Canadian Space Agency says: «Over the course of a long-duration mission, astronauts must exercise approximately two hours per day» (asc-csa.gc.ca, «Physical activity in space», read on 2026-10-13). That is the two hours of the whole daily exercise, aerobic and resistive. It agrees with OCHMO-MTB-013 Rev D (p. 14): «Previous requirements have been 2 hours per workday with a strict exercise program». It differs from OCHMO-TB-031 (p. 10), which gives for flight «Approximately 30 minutes of interval or steady-state exercise» plus «30-60 minutes load-bearing training», 60 to 90 minutes (read on 2026-10-14): none of the three says what accounts for the difference, and it is not resolved here.
strings.Rutina de ejercicio diario en la ISS con: Daily exercise routine on the ISS with treadmill, cycle ergometer and ARED.
strings.diseño EMMA: tres días para que el efect: EMMA design: three days for the effect of the sessions to show in the resting heart rate
strings.El esfuerzo eleva el pulso y la presión: Exertion raises heart rate and blood pressure during and just after the session: the follow-up measurement is taken at rest.
strings.Revisar hidratación y carga de sal antes: Consider reviewing hydration and salt load before the next sleep period.
strings.Cambios de presión o pulso compatibles c: Changes in blood pressure or heart rate that may be related to fluid redistribution.
strings.Repetir la medida en reposo tras 10 minu: Consider repeating the measurement at rest after 10 minutes seated, to rule out an artifact.
Isolated reading outside the usual range.
strings.lo fija el propio procedimiento (diseño: set by the procedure itself (EMMA design)
strings.diseño EMMA: la repetición es inmediata: EMMA design: the repeat is immediate
strings.Proteger el periodo de sueño: cortar tar: Consider protecting the sleep period: stopping tasks and screens 60 min beforehand.
strings.Pérdida de sueño o caída de la vigilanci: Sleep loss or a drop in vigilance.
strings.Es tiempo de agenda sin tareas antes de: It is schedule time free of tasks before sleep, not a task. OCHMO-MTB-009 (p. 4) says: «1-2 hrs before bedtime: avoid use of electronic devices or wear blue blocker glasses or night setting to eliminate/reduce blue light emissions» (read on 2026-10-14). The source gives one to two hours; EMMA's action takes the lower end, 60 minutes.
strings.Buenas prácticas de NASA para el sueño:: NASA good practices for sleep: no electronic devices or bright light for one to two hours before sleep.
strings.Ajustar la iluminación al ciclo de misió: Consider adjusting the lighting to the mission cycle to re-anchor the circadian rhythm.
strings.OCHMO-MTB-009 (p. 4) da cuándo, no cuánt: OCHMO-MTB-009 (p. 4) gives when, not how long: «1-2 hrs Before Bedtime: Avoidance of bright light/blue enriched light/high Correlated Temperature Light (CCT)» and «1-2 hrs After Waking: Seek bright light/blue enriched light/high (CCT)» (read on 2026-10-14). The crew time to adjust the light has no source.
strings.Buenas prácticas de NASA para el momento: NASA good practices for the timing of light: avoiding bright light before sleep and seeking it on waking.
strings.Repetir el test PVT tras el próximo peri: Consider repeating the PVT test after the next sleep period, to check the result.
strings.Tiempo de reacción o fallos del PVT por: PVT reaction time or lapses above the usual.
strings.La duración sale del artículo que validó: The duration comes from the article that tested the brief version against the standard one, not from the Roadmap task cited as protocol, whose page does not publish the duration: «we developed a modified brief 3-min version of the PVT (PVT-B)» (Basner et al., Acta Astronaut 2011;69(11-12):949-959, doi:10.1016/j.actaastro.2011.07.015, PMID 22025811; abstract read on PubMed on 2026-10-13). Compared in the laboratory with the 10-minute version; that abstract does not speak of its use on the ISS.
strings.El PVT como autoevaluación de fatiga de: The PVT as a fatigue self-assessment for the crew on the ISS.
strings.diseño EMMA: tras el siguiente periodo d: EMMA design: after the next sleep period
strings.Programar contacto con familia o tripula: Consider scheduling contact with family or crew outside the work shift.
strings.Refugiarse de inmediato en la zona blind: Consider taking shelter immediately in the designated shielded area.
strings.bolsas de estiba, agua y víveres como ma: stowage bags, water and food supplies as shielding mass
strings.NASA dice de Orion: «If the warning were: NASA says of Orion: «If the warning were to sound, the crew would create the shelter within an hour and in some cases would need to stay inside for as long as 24 hours» (nasa.gov, article of 22 September 2016, read on 2026-10-13). The figure is the upper bound for set-up given by the article, not a measurement.
strings.Procedimiento de refugio de Orion: aviso: Orion shelter procedure: HERA warning, set-up with onboard mass, stay.
strings.Permanencia de hasta 24 h en el refugio: Stay of up to 24 h in the Orion shelter (same source).
strings.Trasladarse al módulo con mayor blindaje: Consider moving to the module with the most shielding available.
strings.Tasa de radiación absorbida elevada o ex: High absorbed radiation rate, or accumulated exposure close to the career limit.
strings.módulo con más masa entre la tripulación: module with the most mass between the crew and the outside
strings.El principio: interponer masa de baja de: The principle: placing low-density mass between the crew and the source.
strings.Suspender actividad extravehicular hasta: Consider suspending extravehicular activity until the event subsides.
strings.Evento solar o tasa de radiación absorbi: Solar event or high absorbed radiation rate.
strings.Registrar la lectura del dosímetro perso: Consider recording the personal dosimeter reading in the mission history.
strings.Cualquier cambio en el entorno radiológi: Any change in the radiation environment.
strings.Completar la sesión de ejercicio resisti: Consider completing the high-load resistive exercise session.
strings.Marcadores de resorción ósea al alza o p: Bone resorption markers rising, or low impact loading.
strings.OCHMO-TB-031 (p. 10, «Inflight Training: OCHMO-TB-031 (p. 10, «Inflight Training Time Prescriptions», adapted from Loehr et al., 2015) says: «Resistive/Strength: 30-60 minutes load-bearing training» (read on 2026-10-14). The figure is the top of the range, not a measurement. The chapter by Comfort and Twine on NTRS (20250005889, 2025) gives «60 minutes per session» on average for resistive exercise.
strings.Prescripción de NASA para el entrenamien: NASA's figures for in-flight resistive training and its duration per session.
strings.diseño EMMA: una semana, el marcador cam: EMMA design: one week, the marker changes slowly
strings.Verificar la ingesta de calcio y vitamin: Consider checking the day's calcium and vitamin D intake.
strings.OCHMO-MTB-013 Rev D no da el tiempo de r: OCHMO-MTB-013 Rev D does not give the time to review the intake: no source.
strings.NASA vigila el calcio y la vitamina D de: NASA monitors the crew's calcium and vitamin D, and the assessment of the diet in orbit helps to ensure nutrient intake.
strings.OCHMO-MTB-013 Rev D (p. 15, columna «Con: OCHMO-MTB-013 Rev D (p. 15, «Cons» column) says it of the nutrient, not of reviewing the intake: of calcium, «Excess may cause kidney stones»; of vitamin D, «Requires supplementation, risk of hypercalcemia» (read on 2026-10-14). Reviewing the intake also looks at whether there is too much, not only too little.
strings.Registrar la carga de impacto acumulada: Consider recording the day's accumulated impact loading.
strings.Registrar síntomas en el diario clínico: Consider recording symptoms in the clinical diary with their start time.
strings.Cambios en el recuento o reactivación vi: Changes in the count, or viral reactivation.
strings.Extremar higiene y aislamiento de superf: Consider stepping up hygiene and the isolation of shared surfaces.
strings.Tomar muestra para el ensayo de reactiva: Consider taking a sample for the viral reactivation assay, if it is available.
strings.Mehta et al. (NPJ Microgravity 2017;3:11: Mehta et al. (NPJ Microgravity 2017;3:11, doi:10.1038/s41526-017-0015-y, PMID 28649633), «Sample collection» section of the methods, on the saliva collected in flight by 23 ISS crew members for the latent virus assay: «To collect a sample, the subject placed the cotton roll in their mouth until it became saturated with saliva (2–3 min)» (full text read on Europe PMC, PMC5445581, on 2026-10-20). The source gives two to three minutes; EMMA's action takes the top of the range, 3 minutes, not a measurement. It is the time with the cotton roll in the mouth: the article does not give the time to put the sample in its bag with the stability buffer, nor the time to stow it.
strings.Fuente del tiempo de recogida: cómo reco: Source of the collection time: how the ISS crew collected saliva for the latent virus assay. It is a study, not a NASA operational protocol.
strings.Repetir la medida en ambos ojos con la m: Consider repeating the measurement in both eyes with the same technique, to rule out an artifact.
strings.Diámetro de la vaina del nervio óptico p: Optic nerve sheath diameter above the usual.
strings.Registrar en el diario clínico cualquier: Consider recording any change in vision or focus in the clinical diary.
Changes that may be related to SANS.
strings.Revisar la tendencia con el médico de a: Consider reviewing the trend with the onboard physician against the preflight baseline.
strings.Tendencia sostenida del diámetro de la v: Sustained trend in the sheath diameter.
strings.Intentar la micción y repetir la medida: Consider attempting to void and repeating the measurement, to tell filling from retention.
strings.Registrar la ingesta de líquidos y las m: Consider recording fluid intake and voids over the last few hours.
strings.Revisar el volumen tras la micción con e: Consider reviewing the post-void volume with the onboard physician.
strings.Repetir el registro de dolor en el mapa: Consider repeating the pain record on the body map after the next rest period.
strings.Anotar la actividad previa al dolor: eje: Consider noting the activity before the pain: exercise, task or working posture.
strings.Revisar la evolución por zonas con el mé: Consider reviewing the course by body area with the onboard physician.
strings.Repartir la ingesta de agua a lo largo d: Consider spreading water intake across the day up to the target of the hydration protocol.
strings.Ingesta de líquidos u orina de 24 h a la: Fluid intake or 24 h urine falling, or urine specific gravity rising.
strings.NASA mide la producción de orina para vi: NASA measures urine output to monitor the risk of kidney stones and to adjust diet, exercise and hydration.
strings.diseño EMMA: dos recogidas de orina de 2: EMMA design: two 24 h urine collections
strings.Registrar la ingesta de líquidos y la or: Consider recording fluid intake and 24 h urine with the same technique as the baseline.
strings.Revisar el menú con el equipo de aliment: Consider reviewing the menu with the food team on Earth: variety, choice and preferred foods available.
strings.Aceptabilidad de la comida o ingesta ene: Food acceptability or energy intake falling.
strings.La variedad, la elección y la aceptabili: Variety, choice and acceptability shape what is actually eaten.
strings.diseño EMMA: una semana de menús: EMMA design: one week of menus
strings.Registrar lo que realmente se come en ca: Consider recording what is actually eaten at each meal, including what is left.
strings.Ingesta energética a la baja o sin regis: Energy intake falling or not recorded.
strings.Contrastar la lectura de CO2 del módulo: Consider cross-checking the module's CO2 reading against a second sensor or a portable measurement.
strings.CO2 de cabina fuera del límite de una ho: Cabin CO2 outside the one-hour limit of NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6004].
strings.segundo sensor o analizador portátil de: second sensor or portable CO2 analyzer
strings.[V2 6022]: el sistema alerta cuando los: [V2 6022]: the system alerts when atmospheric parameters leave their limits; [V2 6004]: one-hour CO2 limit.
strings.diseño EMMA: el límite se juzga en media: EMMA design: the limit is judged on a one-hour average
strings.Revisar el estado del sistema de elimina: Consider reviewing the state of the CO2 removal system and the module's ventilation.
strings.CO2 de cabina fuera de límite de forma s: Cabin CO2 outside its limit in a sustained way.
strings.[V2 6004]: el sistema limita la media de: [V2 6004]: the system limits the one-hour average of CO2 to 3 mmHg; ventilation prevents CO2 pockets.

strings.Lectura de monóxido de carbono de cabina: Cabin carbon monoxide reading outside its standard limit.
